changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CommentVote') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[CommentVote]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [CommentID] [int] NOT NULL, [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [Vote] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_CommentVote_Vote] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_CommentVote] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_CommentVote_Comment') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CommentVote] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_CommentVote_Comment] FOREIGN KEY([CommentID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Comment] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CommentVote] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_CommentVote_Comment] END

changeSet.sql: if not exists(select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_NAME = 'CommentVote' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Emoji') BEGIN alter table CommentVote add Emoji int constraint DF_CommentVote_Emoji default(1) not null END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: if exists(select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_NAME = 'CommentVote' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Vote') BEGIN exec('update CommentVote set Emoji = iif(Vote = 1, 1, 2)') END
